new_interesting_lines: *[[Exo-Filter]] - Slipstream's offensive capabilities rely on Backstab a lot, which can return into health and will soon become her worst nightmare.
*[[Grimlock]]’s Signature Ability will not be able to purify Slipstream’s backstab debuffs making it one of the few that bypasses the Dino Rage ability
*[[Ironhide]] - Slipstream will have nothing to Backstab to enhance Special 1 if Ironhide keeps messing up with Armors.
*[[Megatronus]]’s ability to switch relics will only be delayed if Slipstream messes with his power bar.
*[[Tech]] bots need power to activate their best abilities, and Slipstream has a number of ways to mess with the opponent’s Power Bar. She can also remove Shock and destroy Tech Shields.

*[[Warrior]] bots love to deal Critical Hits and cause Bleed damage. Slipstream’s low health and lack of Purifying abilities mean she can’t take a lot of damage. Slipstream also can’t activate her Backstab ability while under the effects of Damaging Debuffs.

==Game Abilities==

===Basic Abilities===
*Crit Rate Buff
*Backstab
*Power Drain

=== Abilities ===

* Passive
** 10% chance to evade Heavy Attacks for each Debuff on the opponent. (Max Evade 90%)
* Heavy Attacks
** Slipstream is Invulnerable to Ranged Attacks while in her jet mode.
** <s>+80%</s> 100% chance to gain +15% Critical Damage for 7 seconds.
* Basic Ranged Attacks
** 100% chance to Nullify a Shield Buff.
** 30% chance to gain +20% Attack for 5 seconds.
* 2nd Medium Combo Hit/Last hit of a Medium Combo
** Purify all Shock Debuffs. If any Shock Debuffs were removed, apply a Shock debuff dealing 60% of Attack over 8 seconds.
**Gain +10% Critical Rate up for 6 seconds.
* Backstab
** When Slipstream lands a Critical Hit, 25~60% chance for the attack to Backstab. Increase the chance to Backstab by 12% per Power Bar the opponent has.
** Slipstream cannot perform Backstab while she has any Damaging Debuffs.
** Backstab cycles between 3 different effects:
*** 20% Crit Resistance Debuff for 8 seconds. (Max Stacks: 1)
*** 30% Power Rate down for 8 seconds. (Max Stacks: 1)
*** Backfire Debuff for 8 seconds. (Max Stacks: 1)
